$comment: Label vocabulary /port:init creates in a managed repository.
Each entry names the module that owns it. `core` labels are always created; a label
owned by an optional module is created only when that module is enabled, so a
repository with previewDatabase off never gets the two refresh labels.
`key` is the port.config.json `labels` key. `name` is the default string, which a
repository may override there. Agents read the configured name, never these defaults
directly.
Colours group by role — triggers blue, in-flight amber, gates red, terminal green —
and each role is an ordered Primer ramp, light to dark in pipeline order, so position
within the role is legible from colour alone, not just the role itself.
`claude` is the one deliberate exception: Claude coral (`D97757`), off the role grouping,
because it marks ownership rather than stage. It is also the only single-member family.
`auto plan` keeps the slate that `claude` used to share, now the exact Primer grey.
Gates step two shades at a time (5 -> 7 -> 9) rather than one, so severity reads from a
large lightness delta rather than hue alone — legible under red-green colour vision
deficiency. Terminal keeps `pr opened` at the shade operators already know and pushes
`approved` deeper, since it is the actual finish line.
A module-gated label (`refreshBranch`, `refreshing`) always takes its family's last,
boundary-adjacent step: it is out-of-band and absent in most repositories, so it is the
one that can afford to sit nearest the text-contrast threshold.

labels.name: claude
labels.description: The port pipeline owns this item

labels.name: auto plan
labels.description: Plan gate skipped: the plan is auto-approved

labels.name: plan changes requested
labels.description: Trigger: revise the plan from human feedback

labels.name: refresh branch
labels.description: Trigger: rebase and force-push, no code changes

labels.name: planning
labels.description: In flight: a plan is being researched

labels.name: plan review
labels.description: Gate: plan written, awaiting human approval

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Gate: needs a human decision, details in a comment

labels.name: needs human
labels.description: Gate: the pipeline stopped and needs a person

labels.name: pr opened
labels.description: Terminal on the issue: state now lives on the pull request

labels.name: approved
labels.description: Terminal: findings are at or under the bar, a human merges
